subject: Week-of-03-11 Exec Digest — OKR micro-checks, QBR runbook & action roster
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Exec-Staff <exec-staff@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Week-of-03-11 Exec Digest — OKR micro-checks, QBR runbook & action roster

Morning all — quick, focused status for the week. We’re in the final stretch for the QBR packet; below are the short wins, elevated risks, and concrete asks to keep things on track. I’ve attached a trimmed runbook and the OKR micro-check tracker. Please read the asks and reply inline if you own any action.

Wins:
- Hosting: Dedicated pool latency improvement — 8% p50 gain in staging after kernel update. Low risk to rollout schedule.
- Customer success: Three pilot customers converted to paid trials this week (notes in tracker).
- Observability: Token-level cost breakdown is now in the console for all routes — helpful to validate the Optimize suggestions.

Risks / Blockers:
- QBR data freshness: Two key dashboards still missing verified token-cost exports; Finance will not sign off until those show 24h of consistent data (owner: Karthik).
- Dedicated capacity forecasting: We lack a finalized burst-cap policy for EU region; possible throttling for enterprise demos next week (owner: Laura).
- Eval regressions: Small quality drift on zwm-13 for long-context replies flagged by research (owner: Jonas).

Asks / Actions (owner | due):
- Karthik | 2029-03-13: Deliver verified token-cost CSV + short note for Finance.
- Laura | 2029-03-14: Confirm EU burst-cap policy and provide fallbacks for demo routes.
- Jonas | 2029-03-13: Postmortem summary for zwm-13 regression and mitigation plan.
- Marissa | 2029-03-15: Consolidate customer one-pagers into the QBR appendix (I want one-line value props for each pilot).

Attachments: [attachment: QBR-Runbook-v2.pdf (application/pdf)], [attachment: OKR-Microchecks-Tracker.ods (application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet)]

Thanks — short updates before EOD please so I can lock the runbook on Friday.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Exec-Staff <exec-staff@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week-of-03-11 Exec Digest — OKR micro-checks, QBR runbook & action roster

Thanks Sean — quick replies inline.

- EU burst-cap policy: I’ll own this. Current ask is to increase regional burst by 20% for demo windows; infrastructure has raised security and capacity review items that I’ll close out by Thu. If we can’t sign before the demo, we’ll use the hosted fallback and I’ll document the route mapping in the runbook.
- I’ll also add a short escalation bullet for the sales field so SDRs know the fallback path.

Will update by Thu EOD.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff
Redwood Inference

1) Product blurbs — can product leads provide a 25-word impact statement for each pilot by Wed COB? I’ll stitch and format.
2) Customer logos/permissions — legal needs an explicit OK from each pilot to use logos in the QBR deck; I’ll send the template email today.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 13 Mar 2029 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week-of-03-11 Exec Digest — OKR micro-checks, QBR runbook & action roster

Sean — quick update on token-cost exports. I deployed the export job last night and validated two sample buckets. Pushing full 24h run now; ETA for signed CSV and short note for Finance is Thu 2029-03-14 17:00 PT. If Finance needs an interim sample earlier, I can drop an anonymized extract.

On the forecasting side: I recommend we use the conservative burst policy for QBR demos and note the waived SLA if we hit caps; this keeps predictable unit economics for the quarter.

—Karthik
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Exec-Staff <exec-staff@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Week-of-03-11 Exec Digest — OKR micro-checks, QBR runbook & action roster

Folks — final quick readout on the zwm-13 drift. Short summary: regression is tied to a recent tokenizer patch that affected long-context sampling probabilities. Mitigation: rolled back tokenizer change in staging and queued a targeted fix for 2029-03-18 deployment. No customer-facing impact observed to date; I’ll post a short postmortem to the drive and flag any learnings for the runbook.

Closing note: I aligned with Marissa on appendix format — she has the final copy. Sean, if you want, I can add a two-line technical appendix that explains the zwm-13 mitigation for leadership.

—Jonas
Director, Applied ML
Redwood Inference
